product.name: SimpleCitizen Immigration Application Platform
product.description: A digital platform that guides users through preparing, reviewing, and submitting immigration applications to USCIS.

product.name: Eligibility Quiz
product.description: An online tool that helps users determine which immigration benefits they may qualify for by answering a few questions.

product.name: Immigration Attorney Review Service
product.description: A service where independent licensed immigration attorneys review and provide legal feedback on users' immigration applications.

product.name: Application Printing, Assembly, and Shipping
product.description: A service that prints, compiles, and ships the finalized immigration application package to the user's home or a pickup location.

product.name: Certified Document Translation
product.description: Translation of government-issued documents required for immigration applications into English.
